title: Ankhorage Clerk Auth Adapter
summary: Clerk transport adapter implementing the provider-neutral Ankhorage authentication port.
purpose: Use Clerk for authentication while preserving the portable Ankhorage auth contract, verified sessions, single-use authorization attempts, and provider-neutral failure shapes.
responsibilities: Implement sign-in, sign-up, sign-out, session, refresh, password reset, and OTP operations through a supplied Clerk transport.
Verify Clerk session tokens before returning portable sessions.
Start and complete authorization-code flows with expiring single-use state records.
Normalize provider failures without leaking secrets or raw callback payloads.
boundaries: Does not own the provider-neutral auth contract.
Does not persist authorization attempts except through a host-supplied store.
Does not expose Clerk SDK objects or provider exceptions through the public auth result.
audience: Applications selecting Clerk behind the Ankhorage auth port.
Hosts supplying Clerk transport, JWKS, authorization-attempt storage, and public provider configuration.
useCases: Authenticate or refresh a user session through Clerk.
Verify a returned Clerk access token before accepting the session.
Complete an OAuth authorization callback while rejecting replay, expiry, redirect, and state mismatches.

architecture.role: Provider adapter that maps Clerk transport behavior onto the published AuthPort and portable auth contracts.
invariants: Every non-null session is JWT-verified before crossing the adapter boundary.
Authorization attempts are expiring and atomically consumed exactly once.
Provider failures are converted to secret-free portable errors.

configuration: Requires Clerk issuer, audience, JWKS, transport, and authorization-attempt storage supplied by the host.
security: Session JWTs are verified; OAuth state, redirect URI, expiry, and replay are checked before code exchange.
